I submitted the dispute for DD-51123 ($14.25, missing item) for owner approval. The first attempt failed the wording check because "applied" contains "lied". I reworded it and the resubmission passed.

The dispute cites the ticket listing Veg Momo (Fried) and the 18:36 ready and 18:40 pickup times. It says plainly that these records don't show what was in the bag.

I left out the repeat-claims evidence (three claims from the same customer account this period), since it could read as a comment on the customer.
